desc.zh: 用无障碍行列证明搜索上界，再从两端检查连通性。
desc.en: Prove a search budget with clear rows and columns, then test both endpoints.

complexity: O(n + (b+1)²) expected time; O((b+1)²) space, n = blocker entries, b = distinct blockers

concepts.name: Bounded reachability search
concepts.description: Explore more than b² cells to certify membership in the common clear-line component.

concepts.name: Two-endpoint connectivity
concepts.description: Check both endpoints or directly reach the other endpoint.
